name: Shares' reinvested dividends are taxed; a fund's kept income isn't
workings: The plan's incomeYield reports 2,000 of dividends on shares and 3,000 of income an ETF kept
Dividends on shares are paid and taxed even when reinvested: (2,000 − 1,000 allowance) × 25% = 250, Soli 13.75; reinvesting them buys shares, so the purchase cost rises by 2,000
An accumulating fund's income is part of its rise, which the Vorabpauschale taxes (here there's no balance, so nothing)
